decisions.reason: The sweet pastry is a low-cost extension of the core confectionery range, and nothing suggests it falls below aspiration, though it has not been seen on the website since 2018.
The farmhouse bread sits close to the established offer and is cheap to carry, but the earlier withdrawal of the similar hearty loaf shows bread line-ups get pruned, so some risk remains.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is a flagship whose results exceed aspiration levels, so there is no trigger for search and every reason to retain it.
The premium stollen also won gold and strengthens the seasonal gift business, so its performance meets aspirations and justifies keeping it.
